secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (e.g. https://your-project.supabase.co). If not set, the app uses a local PostgREST backend via the Vite proxy.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/public API key. A development placeholder is provided; replace with your real key to use a cloud Supabase instance.
